At t0 W legally casts Arcane Mortar for13RP40→27. At t1 W spends its normal Bonus Action command, names perceived T20ft from the cannon, and retains the shared offensive allowance pending actual firing. W remains in its own regular slot until t2.

At t1.5 W gives the visible signal. Immediately after that trigger, C spends its available Reaction and chooses/rechecks point(20,0,2.5), within10ft with clear LoE. The same paid Lesser Antimagic manifests radius10 there; normal concentration would end at61.5 absent earlier ending. This is not a new cast or second RP payment. The field covers the cannon; its own same-family exemption preserves the field while C is within it.

At the actual attached phase t2 the cannon is locally suppressed. No shot starts; ammo remains3, the shared offensive allowance was not consumed by this cannon, and the already-paid command is lost rather than queued.
At t3 C ends field concentration through its actual no-Action permission. The same physical cannon resumes HP30/ammo3 with its original expiry60. No shot fires at resumption.

At W regular turn[6,8], W may spend a new available BA command on the same legal T. With no other shared offensive use that round, the attached phase t8 starts one shot: natural12+8=20 hits AC14; 5d6 faces[3,3,4,4,4]=18 force. Ammo3→2 and T200→182; one source-owner damage root, no Wound threshold or concentration on T. This concrete later use does not refund either earlier command or extend the original deadline.

Independent destruction composition: the stipulated legal30 force reduces the object to0 before firing; it is destroyed and vanishes, with no remaining original debris or100lb salvage. A repair that requires actual debris cannot reconstruct it. This branch is not a fabricated current attack execution.
